parsed.seniority_signal: Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit Python
parsed.german_signal: Sehr gutes Deutsch (mind. C1) in Wort und Schrift
parsed.degree_signal: ein Studium der Data Science, Informatik, Mathematik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung
parsed.notes:
Only candidate qualifications are labeled; technologies appearing solely under responsibilities are excluded.
The entire “Ein Plus: Idealerweise” paragraph is optional.
The optional experience list is read literally as alternatives: document processing, Agentic AI, or DevSecOps. Group 2 contains its two taxonomy-mapped members; Kubernetes and Terraform are tools accompanying DevSecOps, not alternatives to each other.
LangChain has no alternative group because “einer vergleichbaren Bibliothek” names no second skill.
Generic database knowledge and document processing are left unmapped rather than narrowed to particular database types or extraction techniques.
The degree fields are educational subjects, not separate skill requirements. Understanding the performance effects of design decisions is not treated as an explicit request for software architecture.
